category.description: Optional topic keyword to filter top content (e.g. 'AI', 'leadership', 'marketing'). Leave empty to scrape general trending posts.
category.title: Category / Topic Keyword

cookie.description: LinkedIn session cookie for authenticated access to more posts. Accepts: (1) the li_at value, or (2) full cookies JSON array from an export extension. Without cookie, only the public trending feed is available.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie (optional)

dateRange.description: Only return posts published in the selected window (LinkedIn's own time bucket). Leave empty for any time.
dateRange.title: Date Range

language.description: Preferred response language for LinkedIn API requests (affects post translation and surfaced posts).
language.title: Language

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of top content posts to scrape.
maxPosts.title: Max Posts

mediaTypeFilter.description: Only return posts of a specific media type. Leave empty to return all types.
mediaTypeFilter.title: Media Type Filter

minComments.description: Only return posts with at least this many comments. Leave empty (or 0) for no minimum.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Only return posts with at least this many reactions. Leave empty (or 0) for no minimum.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for better results with cookie-based access.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
